2607.29241.title: RecHarness: A Bandit-Routed Agentic Harness for Self-Evolving Recommender Systems
2607.29241.paper_summary: Optimizing modern recommender models still depends heavily on engineers manually iterating over architectural, objective, and training-strategy changes. While LLM-based agents can automate this trial-and-error process, allowing the LLM to both select modification directions and generate concrete hypotheses often leads to unstable search under limited experiment budgets. Inspired by the above challenge, we propose RecHarness, a Bandit-Routed Agentic Harness for automated recommender model optimization. RecHarness separates the optimization process into two steps: a bandit router selects the next modification direction according to historical validation feedback, while the LLM generates a concrete optimization hypothesis and executable code edit within the selected direction. To sustain long-horizon exploration, RecHarness uses a jump-basin mechanism to activate a structural-jump arm when local edits stagnate. Across multiple recommendation tasks, datasets, and model backbones, RecHarness achieves more stable performance improvements and uses limited trial budgets more effectively than LLM-reasoning search. During a 7-day online A/B test on a large-scale short-video advertising platform, the selected candidate improves ADVV by 2.084%, Revenue by 0.534%, and Exposure by 0.559%. Code is available at https://github.com/6lyc/RecHarness.
2607.29241.paper_summary_zh: 優化現代推薦模型仍然在很大程度上依賴於工程師手動迭代架構、目標和訓練策略的變更。雖然基於LLM的代理可以自動化這一試錯過程，但讓LLM同時選擇修改方向並生成具體假設，往往會在有限的實驗預算下導致不穩定的搜索。受到上述挑戰的啟發，我們提出了RecHarness，一種用於自動化推薦模型優化的Bandit-Routed Agentic Harness。RecHarness將優化過程分為兩個步驟：一個bandit路由器根據歷史驗證反饋選擇下一個修改方向，而LLM則在所選方向內生成具體的優化假設和可執行的代碼編輯。為了維持長期探索，RecHarness使用跳躍盆地機制來激活結構跳躍臂，當局部編輯停滯時。 在多個推薦任務、數據集和模型骨幹中，RecHarness實現了更穩定的性能提升，並比LLM推理搜索更有效地利用有限的試驗預算。在一個大型短視頻廣告平台上進行的為期7天的在線A/B測試中，所選候選者使ADVV提高了2.084%，收入提高了0.534%，曝光率提高了0.559%。代碼可在 https://github.com/6lyc/RecHarness 獲得。
